c.title: $4,150 / 2br - 741ft2 - Brand New 2 Bed + 2 Bath at 2 Burrard Place | 33rd Floor Views (Vancouver)
c.description:
Welcome to 2 Burrard Place! This brand-new 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom corner residence offers exceptional 33rd-floor northeast views across the city and toward the mountains, with floor-to-ceiling windows bringing in abundant natural light.

The home features wide-plank hardwood flooring, A/C, a private balcony, and a sleek Italian kitchen with premium Gaggenau appliances, integrated cabinetry, and a contemporary stone island. Spa-inspired bathrooms are finished in floor-to-ceiling stone with heated floors and Cielo Italian fixtures. Thoughtful upgrades include motorized window blinds and an upgraded integrated lighting control system.

Residents enjoy access to approximately 30,000 sq. ft. of Club One amenities, including an indoor pool, fitness and wellness facilities, social and entertainment spaces, and concierge service.

Ideally located in the heart of downtown Vancouver, moments from Yaletown, False Creek, the seawall, dining, shopping, and transit.

Terms:
Minimum one-year lease
Available immediately
Unfurnished
1 parking stall
1 40sqft storage locker
1 dedicated bike lock
Tenant insurance required
Pets negotiable

Please text Alex at show contact info with a brief introduction to book a viewing!
